messages:
Ivy (CS): Day 1 check-in for Aurelia private VPC onboarding. Customer saw a couple of 502s to internal object-store during their nightly backup window (02:10-02:25 UTC). They flagged renewals if we don’t stabilize. Opening CS-8302.

Nikhil P: Quick triage: ELB shows connection resets at 02:12. Suspect PMTU/MSS on their site-to-site VPN + KMS rotation storm. Need their tunnel MTU and KMS rotation time.

Aurelia NetOps: Tunnel MTU is 1500, but we do see drops beyond ~1420 on path tests. We can try MSS clamp to 1400 for a test window tonight.

Harper G: KMS note: they rotate daily at 02:15 and backups read immediately after. That will cause bursty KMS decrypt traffic and transient latency. Options: shift rotation to after backups, stagger backup role, or enable a short decrypt cache for the backup job. Which do they prefer?

Ivy (CS): Actions: @Nikhil gather ELB/natgw graphs + short pcap -> attach to CS-8302; @Harper propose KMS options + short FAQ; @Aurelia NetOps test MSS clamp tonight and share results. If variance >5% over baseline mark renewal_risk and escalate to AM.

Nikhil P: Uploaded graphs + 30s pcap to CS-8302. Evidence: PMTU blackhole when payloads exceed ~1408 bytes. Recommended MSS clamp and re-run path MTU.

Aurelia NetOps: Applied MSS clamp 1400 for test window. We'll run this curl + tcpdump and upload traces at 02:10 UTC:
```
curl -sS -w "%{time_total} %{http_code}\n" -o /dev/null https://internal-s3.aurelia:443 --resolve internal-s3.aurelia:443:10.4.5.7
sudo tcpdump -n -s 0 -c 150 port 443 and host 10.4.5.7
```

Harper G: Drafted KMS FAQ blurb in CS-8302: "If backups read objects immediately after a rotation, you may see transient decrypt latency. Recommended: shift rotation 30m post-backup or use a warm-cache for backup role." Added cross-account audit snippet placeholder.

OnboardBot: Ticket CS-8302 updated  assignees: Nikhil P, Harper G, Aurelia NetOps. Status: investigation. Next update requested within 8h.

Ivy (CS): Customer feedback captured: they want a one-page "network + KMS pre-cutover checklist" and explicit note about scheduling rotations around backups. I'll add renewal_risk flag and follow-up with AM if instability continues. Please keep updates in the ticket for customer-facing timeline. :memo:
